title: The Runaway Finish Line
premise: A runner wants one finish-line photograph, but a breeze keeps carrying the ribbon ahead. After increasingly ridiculous sprints, the runner stops chasing, ties the ribbon between two stationary trees, and strolls through while the exhausted photographer gets the action shot.
hook: The finish line has entered the race.
visible_action: Ribbon bows forward; legs blur; photographer crab-walks backward; runner anchors both ribbon ends and takes one tiny step.
intended_takeaway_or_theme: Check whether the target itself is moving.
gate: Use a cartoon breeze and harmless running; do not imply an exercise or photography technique.

style_application.material: Ink on an original textured stage
style_application.why: The changing distance to the ribbon and the character’s strategy stay readable.
style_application.check: Check foot contact, ribbon continuity and the earned resolution.

editorial_pick.original_reason: A moving finish line is immediately understandable and gives the character a clear change of strategy.
editorial_pick.proposed_first_version: Articulated line runner, readable ribbon motion and three restrained camera setups. Finish on the quiet step through the anchored ribbon.
editorial_pick.gate: Check ribbon continuity, original character design and a safe cartoon tone.
editorial_pick.note: These are the catalogue's historical editorial recommendations, not current owner-approved selections or guaranteed watchable stories. Reapply the latest comedy/suspense gate.
